title: Theo Browne's $1M+/yr creator-founder setup: a paywalled Indie Hackers teaser
summary: Only the intro of this Indie Hackers profile is readable; the rest is paywalled and the body is mostly reader comments. Theo says he splits focus between his YouTube channel and T3 Tools (T3 Chat, T3 Code), keeps older products running at low effort, and has one seven-figure ARR product.

principles.text: Concentrate attention on the channel and the one or two products with momentum; keep older products maintained, not expanded.
principles.quote: I currently focus on my YouTube channel and T3 Tools' products (T3 Chat & T3 Code).

principles.text: Products need not all earn: an open-source free product can build large reach alongside a monetized one.
principles.quote: T3 Code has over 60,000 users in just a few months, but it is open source and not monetized.

principles.text: Revenue concentrates in one product; the others are valuable mainly for reach.
principles.quote: While none of our other products approach T3 Chat's revenue, a few have similar reach.
